## What changes

## Evidence (for any change to what the map says about the law)

- [ ] Primary source linked (Online Sunshine, FLRules, eCFR, Municode or the local code site)
- [ ] Citation in force, subsection checked, quote word for word, URL resolves
- [ ] No invented geometry; any drawing approximation is stated in the zone's `flag`
- [ ] Text states what is closed or restricted, never that water is open
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] `python3 tools/test-data.py` and the smoke test pass
